lead: A `.phpt` section `crates/nvs-test` parses but does not honour fails the case outright; a member needing one is two slices.
body: `case.rs`'s `NOT_YET` table reports such a case `unsupported`, and each entry names a blocker that may have stopped being true. Before a case that sets up its own world, read `NOT_YET`, not the section table in `crates/nvs-test/src/lib.rs`, which lists sections that do nothing too.
